Game Overview

In Slimoban, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a captivating world where sokoban meets slimes. Strategize your moves, pushing boxes while dodging or defeating mischievous slimes using fireballs and water. Each level presents a unique puzzle, challenging your problem-solving skills in a retro-pixelated charm. Can you master all the slime-filled challenges?
